reports.title: First-long-prefill compilation hypotheses: AOT, in-memory reuse, persistent cache
corrections: R1017-C1: The current configured STRATA_SYCL_DEVICE_ARCH is empty, but cmake/sycl_backend.cmake supports AOT and uses the exact project target bmg_g21. Any capability gate must test bmg_g21 through the project-equivalent resolver; the newer Intel -device bmg example does not qualify this older clang or this project image.

R1017-C2: The compiler install bin lacks ocloc, but the pinned build receipt also inventories /usr/bin/ocloc -> /usr/bin/ocloc-26.31.1, SHA-256 76593e79a6a24277305ef6f2ad9fb042028205a0b028cd2beddd98a9681ce9b1. This pins a host command file only; it proves no invocation, version compatibility, bmg_g21 support, or emitted/selected image.

R1017-C3: Preserve the prior clean 602.0/601.5/603.2 and 576.1/576.4/576.4 fresh-process samples and their status. They follow one short 74-token warm-up and one long request per process; do not relabel them as later-long same-process data or compilation time. Main's prepared run_moe_accum_model_first_subsequent_v5.py has not run, so no first-versus-later receipt exists yet.

R1017-C4: tools/strata_bench.py supports four distinct run-tag inputs and checks zero prompt reuse, but the harness does not by itself prove one engine process served all four. Record owner PID and every prompt/reuse value. Keep the active mode-8/10 diagnostics ahead of any new runtime/GPU experiment.

R1017-C5: The first proposed probe is only partly host-only: compiler/help/tool checks can be host-only; cache trace, thread stacks and queue/device event attribution require a later owned runtime diagnostic. Keep those phases separate and keep the existing safe environment fixed. The 12.2548/20.8493s unclassified CPU and 3.3889/3.3916s gemm_submit CPU do not establish JIT causality.
reports.scope_depth_review: Substantive three-way comparison with process/cache lifetime, conditional AOT, phase attribution, code-split tradeoffs, cold/warm request labels and refusal gates. It distinguishes ordinary SYCL JIT from the separate kernel_compiler runtime-compilation feature and makes no measured local cache/AOT claim.
